title: SLO Playback Timeline + Incident Thread Links
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact, actionable 'SLO Playback' timeline surface inside the Redwood Console that ties SLO deltas to specific alert tickets, on-call handoff notes, and postmortem artifacts. The surface should allow engineers and SREs to quickly understand when an SLO breach started, which alerts fired in that window, which on-call handoffs occurred, and surface one-click links to the related incident thread and postmortem. Scope: 1) Timeline row visual showing SLO metric and shaded breach windows, 2) Inline chips for alerts with hover details and sortable by severity, 3) On-call handoff snippets showing assignee changes and handoff notes, 4) Direct links to incident threads and final postmortem documents, 5) Lightweight compact view for route-level dashboards and an expanded modal for full context. Constraints: must work inside existing dashboard grid, support multiple time ranges (1h/6h/24h/7d), and not introduce backend schema changes (use existing alert index and incident links surfaced via metadata). Out of scope: automatic root-cause attribution and change to SLO computation. Deliverables: annotated wireframes, Figma prototype, interaction spec, developer handoff with component tokens and accessibility notes.
acceptance_criteria: Timeline shows SLO value and shaded breach windows for selected time range
Each alert in the breach window is represented as a chip with severity color and hover shows summary + link to alert in console
On-call handoff snippets show time, previous on-call, next on-call, and a short note (if present) with a link to the handoff activity
Clicking a postmortem shortcut opens the postmortem in a new tab; missing postmortems surface a ‘Create postmortem’ CTA linked to the postmortem template
Compact view fits a single dashboard row (height <= 120px) and expanded modal presents full thread with timestamps and linked artifacts
Design tokens and aria-labels provided for developer handoff and pass accessibility review
comments: 2025-02-12 - Kickoff: scoped with ENG-22110 to use existing alert index; agreed to use metadata links for incident/postmortem references. (Aisha)
2025-02-18 - Early wireframes posted in Figma; highlighted challenge around fitting handoff snippets into compact row without crowding token budgets. (Elena)
2025-02-20 - PM feedback: prefer explicit 'Create postmortem' CTA when none exists; also request a keyboard-first interaction for opening threads. (Marco Nguyen)

2025-02-25 - Engineering review: ENG-22345 will add a lightweight incident-link field to alert metadata next sprint; until then we will surface links only when present. Performance team flagged potential cost for additional joins for long time ranges. (Sanjay Kapoor)

2025-02-28 - Usability session (5 participants): success finding link to latest postmortem was 90% for expanded modal, 60% for compact row — recommend stronger affordance in compact state. Adjusted hover affordance and escalated to follow-up prototype. (Elena)
2025-03-03 - Design update: updated Figma with new compact affordance (folded chevron + badge) and added copy for 'Create postmortem' flow; ready for design QA. (Elena)
Next steps: finalize interaction spec, produce accessibility checklist, tag ENG-22110 in handoff PR, schedule design QA with PM and Eng for 2025-03-10.
